     266: function normalizeAllowedSize(size) {
     267:   const allowed = [16, 24, 32, 64, 96, 128, 192, 256];
     268: 
     269:   let s = Number(size);
     270:   if (!Number.isFinite(s) || s <= 0) s = 96;
     271: 
     272:   // arredonda pra cima (se passar 70 -> 96)
     273:   for (const a of allowed) {
     274:     if (s <= a) return a;
     275:   }
     276:   return 256;
     277: }

     279: /**
>>   280:  * ✅ Retorna a URL correta da imagem para o grupo e tamanho.
     281:  * /assets/animals/animais_<size>_png/<grupo2>_<slug>.png
     282:  */
     283: export function getImgFromGrupo(grupo, size = null) {
     284:   const b = getBichoByGrupo(grupo);
     285:   if (!b) return "";
     286: 
     287:   const base = getPublicBase();
     288:   const g2 = pad2(b.grupo);

     290:

     292:   if (!PREFER_ASSETS_FOLDER) {
     293:     return `${base}/img/${b.slug}_${s}.png`;
     294:   }
     295: 
     296:   return `${base}/assets/animals/animais_${s}_png/${g2}_${b.slug}.png`;
     297: }

     424: export async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
     425:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
     426:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 3);
     427:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
     428: 
     429:   let idx = 0;
     430: 
     431:   async function worker() {
     432:     // ✅ claim seguro do próximo índice
     433:     // (evita disputa em cenários com yield/microtasks)
     434:     // eslint-disable-next-line no-constant-condition
     435:     while (true) {
     436:       const current = idx;
     437:       idx += 1;
     438:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
     439:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
     440:     }
     441:   }
     442: 
     443:   await Promise.all(
     444:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
     445:   );
     446: 
     447:   return results;
     448: }

     965: function AparicoesList({ items }) {

     973:           const pct = (safeNumber(x.value) / max) * 100;
     974:

>>   976:             <div key={`${x.grupo ?? x.label}-${idx}`} style={ui.apRow}>

     981:               <div style={ui.apBarWrap}>

     984:               </div>
     985:

      28:   return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(s || "").trim());

      32:   const m = String(ymd || "")
      33:     .trim()
      34:     .match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
      35:   if (!m) return safeStr(ymd);
      36:   return `${m[3]}/${m[2]}/${m[1]}`;

      40:   return new Date();
      41: }

      44:   const d = nowLocal();

     347: function normalizeImgSrc(src) {

     350: 
     351:   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(s)) return s;
     352: 
     353:   const base = publicBase();
     354: 
     355:   if (s.startsWith("/")) return `${base}${s}`;
     356:   if (s.startsWith("public/")) return `${base}/${s.slice("public/".length)}`;
     357:   if (s.startsWith("img/")) return `${base}/${s}`;

>>   362: function makeImgVariantsFromGrupo(grupo, size) {

     390:   }
     391:

     827: function normalizeMetric(value, maxValue) {
     828:   const v = Number(value || 0);
     829:   const m = Number(maxValue || 0);
     830:   if (!Number.isFinite(v) || !Number.isFinite(m) || m <= 0) return 0;
     831:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v / m));
     832: }
     833: 
     834: function clamp01(v) {
     835:   const n = Number(v);
     836:   if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 0;
     837:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n));
     838: }

     840: function buildZeroProbMap(groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
     841:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
     842:   return new Map(Array.from({ length: k }, (_, i) => [i + 1, 0]));

     845: function confidenceFromSamples(samples, fullConfidenceAt = 8) {
     846:   const n = Number(samples || 0);
     847:   const lim = Math.max(1, Number(fullConfidenceAt || 8));
     848:   return clamp01(n / lim);
     849: }

    1644: function detectRegimeFromComparableSequence(seqRecent) {
    1645:   const list = Array.isArray(seqRecent) ? seqRecent : [];
    1646:   const groups = list
>>  1647:     .map((x) => Number(x?.grupo))
    1648:     .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= 25);
    1649: 
    1650:   if (groups.length <= 1) {
    1651:     return {
    1652:       regime: "neutral",
    1653:       repeatRate: 0,
    1654:       uniqueRate: groups.length ? 1 : 0,
    1655:       samples: groups.length,
    1656:     };
    1657:   }
    1658: 
    1659:   let repeats = 0;
    1660:   for (let i = 1; i < groups.length; i += 1) {
    1661:     if (groups[i] === groups[i - 1]) repeats += 1;
    1662:   }
    1663: 
    1664:   const repeatRate = repeats / Math.max(1, groups.length - 1);
    1665:   const uniqueRate = new Set(groups).size / Math.max(1, groups.length);
    1666: 
    1667:   let regime = "neutral";
    1668: 
    1669:   if (repeatRate >= 0.34 || uniqueRate <= 0.5) {
    1670:     regime = "repeat";
    1671:   } else if (repeatRate === 0 && uniqueRate >= 0.84) {
    1672:     regime = "spread";
    1673:   }
    1674: 
    1675:   return {
    1676:     regime,
    1677:     repeatRate,

    2839: function incMap(map, key, value = 1) {
    2840:   const k = Number(key);
    2841:   if (!Number.isFinite(k) || k < 1 || k > TOP3_GROUPS_K) return;
    2842:   map.set(k, Number(map.get(k) || 0) + Number(value || 0));
    2843: }
    2844: 
    2845: function emptyGroupMap() {
    2846:   const out = new Map();
    2847:   for (let g = 1; g <= safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25); g += 1) out.set(g, 0);
    2848:   return out;
    2849: }
    2850:

    2852:   return new Set(
    2853:     getAllTop5Groups(draw)
    2854:       .map((x) => Number(x.grupo))
    2855:       .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= TOP3_GROUPS_K)

    2859: function layerProbability(freqMap, samples, alpha = TOP3_SMOOTH_ALPHA) {
    2860:   const out = new Map();
    2861:   const k = safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25);
    2862:   const a = Math.max(0, Number(alpha || 0));
    2863:   const base = Math.max(0, Number(samples || 0));
    2864:   const denom = Math.max(1, base + (a * k));
    2865: 
    2866:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
    2867:     const count = Math.max(0, Number(freqMap?.get?.(g) || 0));
    2868:     out.set(g, (count + a) / denom);
    2869:   }
    2870: 
    2871:   return out;
    2872: }
    2873: 
    2874: function sampleConfidence(samples, fullAt = 30) {
    2875:   const n = Number(samples || 0);
    2876:   const lim = Math.max(1, Number(fullAt || 30));
    2877:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / lim));
    2878: }

    3437: function buildSceneHypothesisDistribution(sceneRanking, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
    3438:   const ranking = Array.isArray(sceneRanking) ? sceneRanking : [];
    3439:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);

    3441:   const freq = new Map();
    3442:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) freq.set(g, 0);
    3443: 
    3444:   let totalWeight = 0;
    3445: 
    3446:   for (const item of ranking) {
    3447:     const score = Math.max(0, Number(item?.score || 0));
>>  3448:     const nextGrupo = Number(item?.nextDraw ? pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(item.nextDraw) : null);
    3449: 
    3450:     if (!Number.isFinite(nextGrupo) || nextGrupo < 1 || nextGrupo > k) continue;
    3451:     if (score <= 0) continue;
    3452: 
    3453:     freq.set(nextGrupo, Number(freq.get(nextGrupo) || 0) + score);
    3454:     totalWeight += score;
    3455:   }
    3456: 
    3457:   const prob = new Map();
    3458:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
    3459:     prob.set(g, totalWeight > 0 ? Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / totalWeight : 0);
    3460:   }
    3461: 
    3462:   return {
    3463:     freq,
    3464:     prob,
    3465:     samples: ranking.length,
    3466:     totalWeight,
    3467:   };
    3468: }

     573: }

    1644: function detectRegimeFromComparableSequence(seqRecent) {
    1645:   const list = Array.isArray(seqRecent) ? seqRecent : [];
    1646:   const groups = list
>>  1647:     .map((x) => Number(x?.grupo))
    1648:     .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= 25);
    1649: 
    1650:   if (groups.length <= 1) {
    1651:     return {
    1652:       regime: "neutral",
    1653:       repeatRate: 0,
    1654:       uniqueRate: groups.length ? 1 : 0,
    1655:       samples: groups.length,
    1656:     };
    1657:   }
    1658: 
    1659:   let repeats = 0;
    1660:   for (let i = 1; i < groups.length; i += 1) {
    1661:     if (groups[i] === groups[i - 1]) repeats += 1;
    1662:   }
    1663: 
    1664:   const repeatRate = repeats / Math.max(1, groups.length - 1);
    1665:   const uniqueRate = new Set(groups).size / Math.max(1, groups.length);
    1666: 
    1667:   let regime = "neutral";
    1668: 
    1669:   if (repeatRate >= 0.34 || uniqueRate <= 0.5) {
    1670:     regime = "repeat";
    1671:   } else if (repeatRate === 0 && uniqueRate >= 0.84) {
    1672:     regime = "spread";
    1673:   }
    1674: 
    1675:   return {
    1676:     regime,
    1677:     repeatRate,
    1678:     uniqueRate,
    1679:     samples: groups.length,
    1680:   };
    1681: }

    2839: function incMap(map, key, value = 1) {
    2840:   const k = Number(key);
    2841:   if (!Number.isFinite(k) || k < 1 || k > TOP3_GROUPS_K) return;
    2842:   map.set(k, Number(map.get(k) || 0) + Number(value || 0));
    2843: }
    2844:

    2846:   const out = new Map();
    2847:   for (let g = 1; g <= safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25); g += 1) out.set(g, 0);
    2848:   return out;
    2849: }

    2859: function layerProbability(freqMap, samples, alpha = TOP3_SMOOTH_ALPHA) {
    2860:   const out = new Map();
    2861:   const k = safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25);
    2862:   const a = Math.max(0, Number(alpha || 0));
    2863:   const base = Math.max(0, Number(samples || 0));
    2864:   const denom = Math.max(1, base + (a * k));
    2865: 
    2866:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
    2867:     const count = Math.max(0, Number(freqMap?.get?.(g) || 0));
    2868:     out.set(g, (count + a) / denom);
    2869:   }
    2870: 
    2871:   return out;
    2872: }
    2873: 
    2874: function sampleConfidence(samples, fullAt = 30) {
    2875:   const n = Number(samples || 0);
    2876:   const lim = Math.max(1, Number(fullAt || 30));
    2877:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / lim));
    2878: }

    3436: 
    3437: function buildSceneHypothesisDistribution(sceneRanking, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
    3438:   const ranking = Array.isArray(sceneRanking) ? sceneRanking : [];
    3439:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
    3440: 
    3441:   const freq = new Map();
    3442:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) freq.set(g, 0);
    3443: 
    3444:   let totalWeight = 0;
    3445: 
    3446:   for (const item of ranking) {
    3447:     const score = Math.max(0, Number(item?.score || 0));
>>  3448:     const nextGrupo = Number(item?.nextDraw ? pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(item.nextDraw) : null);
    3449: 
    3450:     if (!Number.isFinite(nextGrupo) || nextGrupo < 1 || nextGrupo > k) continue;
    3451:     if (score <= 0) continue;
    3452: 
    3453:     freq.set(nextGrupo, Number(freq.get(nextGrupo) || 0) + score);
    3454:     totalWeight += score;
    3455:   }
    3456: 
    3457:   const prob = new Map();
    3458:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
    3459:     prob.set(g, totalWeight > 0 ? Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / totalWeight : 0);
    3460:   }
    3461: 
    3462:   return {
    3463:     freq,
    3464:     prob,
    3465:     samples: ranking.length,
    3466:     totalWeight,
    3467:   };
    3468: }

    3437: function buildSceneHypothesisDistribution(sceneRanking, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
    3438:   const ranking = Array.isArray(sceneRanking) ? sceneRanking : [];
    3439:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
    3440: 
    3441:   const freq = new Map();
    3442:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) freq.set(g, 0);
    3443: 
    3444:   let totalWeight = 0;
    3445: 
    3446:   for (const item of ranking) {
    3447:     const score = Math.max(0, Number(item?.score || 0));
    3448:     const nextGrupo = Number(item?.nextDraw ? pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(item.nextDraw) : null);
    3449: 
>>  3450:     if (!Number.isFinite(nextGrupo) || nextGrupo < 1 || nextGrupo > k) continue;
    3451:     if (score <= 0) continue;
    3452: 
    3453:     freq.set(nextGrupo, Number(freq.get(nextGrupo) || 0) + score);
    3454:     totalWeight += score;
    3455:   }
    3456: 
    3457:   const prob = new Map();
    3458:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
    3459:     prob.set(g, totalWeight > 0 ? Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / totalWeight : 0);
    3460:   }
    3461: 
    3462:   return {
    3463:     freq,
    3464:     prob,
    3465:     samples: ranking.length,
    3466:     totalWeight,
    3467:   };
    3468: }

     739:   return [...list].sort((a, b) => {

     746:     return tsa - tsb;
     747:   });

     827: function normalizeMetric(value, maxValue) {
     828:   const v = Number(value || 0);
     829:   const m = Number(maxValue || 0);
     830:   if (!Number.isFinite(v) || !Number.isFinite(m) || m <= 0) return 0;
     831:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v / m));
     832: }

    1445: function computeStructuralFirstDistribution(
    1446:   draws,
    1447:   lotteryKey,
    1448:   targetHour,
    1449:   targetDow,
    1450:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
    1451: ) {

    1453:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
    1454:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
    1455:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
    1456: 
    1457:   const firstFreq = new Map();
    1458:   let totalSamples = 0;
    1459: 
    1460:   for (const d of list) {
    1461:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
    1462:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
    1463:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) continue;
    1464: 


LINHAS 1457-1507
    1457:   const firstFreq = new Map();
    1458:   let totalSamples = 0;
    1459: 
    1460:   for (const d of list) {
    1461:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
    1462:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
    1463:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) continue;
    1464: 
    1465:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
    1466:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
    1467:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
    1468:     } else {
    1469:       if (h !== target) continue;
    1470:     }
    1471: 
>>  1472:     const g = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
    1473:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) < 1 || Number(g) > k) continue;
    1474: 
    1475:     totalSamples += 1;
    1476:     firstFreq.set(Number(g), Number(firstFreq.get(Number(g)) || 0) + 1);
    1477:   }
    1478: 
    1479:   const prob = new Map();
    1480:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples);
    1481: 
    1482:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
    1483:     prob.set(g, Number(firstFreq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
    1484:   }
    1485: 
    1486:   return { prob, firstFreq, totalSamples };
    1487: }

    1644: function detectRegimeFromComparableSequence(seqRecent) {
    1645:   const list = Array.isArray(seqRecent) ? seqRecent : [];
    1646:   const groups = list
>>  1647:     .map((x) => Number(x?.grupo))
    1648:     .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= 25);
    1649: 
    1650:   if (groups.length <= 1) {
    1651:     return {
    1652:       regime: "neutral",
    1653:       repeatRate: 0,
    1654:       uniqueRate: groups.length ? 1 : 0,
    1655:       samples: groups.length,
    1656:     };
    1657:   }
    1658: 
    1659:   let repeats = 0;
    1660:   for (let i = 1; i < groups.length; i += 1) {
    1661:     if (groups[i] === groups[i - 1]) repeats += 1;
    1662:   }
    1663: 
    1664:   const repeatRate = repeats / Math.max(1, groups.length - 1);
    1665:   const uniqueRate = new Set(groups).size / Math.max(1, groups.length);
    1666: 
    1667:   let regime = "neutral";
    1668: 
    1669:   if (repeatRate >= 0.34 || uniqueRate <= 0.5) {
    1670:     regime = "repeat";
    1671:   } else if (repeatRate === 0 && uniqueRate >= 0.84) {
    1672:     regime = "spread";
    1673:   }
    1674: 
    1675:   return {
    1676:     regime,
    1677:     repeatRate,
    1678:     uniqueRate,
    1679:     samples: groups.length,
    1680:   };
    1681: }

    2793: function incMap(map, key, value = 1) {
    2794:   const k = Number(key);
    2795:   if (!Number.isFinite(k) || k < 1 || k > TOP3_GROUPS_K) return;
    2796:   map.set(k, Number(map.get(k) || 0) + Number(value || 0));
    2797: }
    2798: 
    2799: function emptyGroupMap() {
    2800:   const out = new Map();
    2801:   for (let g = 1; g <= safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25); g += 1) out.set(g, 0);
    2802:   return out;
    2803: }

    2813: function layerProbability(freqMap, samples, alpha = TOP3_SMOOTH_ALPHA) {
    2814:   const out = new Map();
    2815:   const k = safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25);
    2816:   const a = Math.max(0, Number(alpha || 0));
    2817:   const base = Math.max(0, Number(samples || 0));
    2818:   const denom = Math.max(1, base + (a * k));
    2819: 
    2820:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
    2821:     const count = Math.max(0, Number(freqMap?.get?.(g) || 0));
    2822:     out.set(g, (count + a) / denom);
    2823:   }
    2824: 
    2825:   return out;
    2826: }
    2827: 
    2828: function sampleConfidence(samples, fullAt = 30) {
    2829:   const n = Number(samples || 0);
    2830:   const lim = Math.max(1, Number(fullAt || 30));
    2831:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / lim));
    2832: }

       3: export function normalizeImgSrc(src) {
       4:   const s = String(src || "").trim();

       6: 
       7:   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(s)) return s;

      11: 
      12:   if (s.startsWith("/")) return `${root}${s}`;
      13:   if (s.startsWith("public/")) return `${root}/${s.slice(7)}`;
      14:   if (s.startsWith("img/")) return `${root}/${s}`;
      15: 
      16:   return `${root}/${s}`;
      17: }

       6:   const n = Number(v);
       7:   if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 0;
       8:   if (n > 1) return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / 100));
       9:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n));
      10: }

      17:   const dig = String(v || "").replace(/\D+/g, "");
      18:   if (!dig) return "";
      19:   return dig.length >= 4 ? dig.slice(-4) : dig.padStart(4, "0");

      45: export function normalizeTop3ImgSrc(src, publicBase = "") {
      46:   const s = String(src || "").trim();

      48:   if (/^(https?:)?\/\//i.test(s)) return s;

      55:   return `${base}/${s}`;
      56: }

      27: function drawTs(draw) {
      28:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
      29:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
      30:   if (!y || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
      31: 
      32:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
      33:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
      34:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
      35:   const add = mins >= 0 ? mins * 60 * 1000 : 0;
      36:   return base + add;
      37: }
      38: 
      39: function drawKey(draw) {
      40:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
      41:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
      42:   if (!y || !h) return "";
      43:   return `${y}|${h}`;
      44: }

      27: function drawTs(draw) {
      28:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
      29:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
      30:   if (!y || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
      31: 
      32:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
      33:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
      34:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
      35:   const add = mins >= 0 ? mins * 60 * 1000 : 0;
      36: 
      37:   return base + add;
      38: }

     404:   let invalidPositionCount = 0;

     407:     const prizes = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : [];
     408: 
     409:     if (prizes.length) drawsWithPrizes += 1;
     410:     else drawsWithoutPrizes += 1;

     412:     const ymd = normalizeToYMD(extractRawDateFromDraw(d));

     421:       const gNum = Number(p?.grupo ?? p?.group);
     422:       if (!Number.isFinite(gNum)) {
     423:         missingGrupoCount += 1;
     424:       } else if (gNum < 1 || gNum > 25) {
     425:         invalidGrupoCount += 1;
     426:       }

     431:       } else {

     433:         if (!Number.isFinite(pos) || pos < 1 || pos > 10) {
     434:           invalidPositionCount += 1;
     435:         }
     436:       }

       3: /* ============================================================
       4:    PalPitaco JB — Motor de Sinais (Analytics)
       5:    - Não prevê, não promete: pontua "candidatos" por camadas.
       6:    - Camadas:
>>     7:      (A) Base do horário (frequência do grupo no horário alvo)
       8:      (B) Transição (prevGrupo -> nextGrupo no horário alvo)
       9:      (C) Transição filtrada por Dia da Semana (DOW)
      10:      (D) Transição filtrada por Dia do Mês (DOM)
      11: 
      12:    ✅ FIX IMPORTANTE (produto):
      13:    - Top3 PRECISA TER 3 ITENS.
      14:    - Quando o horário alvo tem pouca amostra (baseCounts < 3),
      15:      fazemos fallback com "base global" (todos horários da grade),
      16:      para completar candidatos e nunca deixar 1 card.
      17: 
      18:    Entrada:
      19:    - drawsRange: lista de draws (preferencialmente detailed), com prizes embutidos
      20:    - schedule: grade válida do PT_RIO para a data analisada
      21:    - ymdTarget: "YYYY-MM-DD"
      22:    - hourBucket: "09:00" etc (alvo efetivo da análise)
      23:    - prevGrupo: grupo do 1º prêmio do sorteio anterior (camada)

       1: // src/services/validateRanking.js
       2: 
       3: function pad2(n) {
       4:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
       5: }
       6: 
       7: function toNumber(v) {
       8:   const n = Number(v);
       9:   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
      10: }
      11: 
      12: /**
>>    13:  * Normaliza qualquer formato de grupo para "01".."25".
      14:  * Aceita:
      15:  * - 7, "7", "07"
      16:  * - "Grupo 7", "GRUPO 07", "G7", "G-07"
      17:  * - "25 - VACA", "grupo:25"
      18:  *
      19:  * Retorna "00" se inválido.
      20:  */
      21: function normalizeGrupo(g) {
      22:   const s0 = String(g ?? "").trim();
      23:   if (!s0) return "00";
      24: 
      25:   // 1) se já vier exatamente "07"
      26:   if (/^\d{2}$/.test(s0)) {
      27:     const n = Number(s0);
      28:     if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || n > 25) return "00";
      29:     return pad2(n);
      30:   }
      31: 
      32:   // 2) se vier "7"
      33:   if (/^\d{1,2}$/.test(s0)) {
      34:     const n = Number(s0);
      35:     if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || n > 25) return "00";
      36:     return pad2(n);
      37:   }
      38: 
      39:   // 3) extrai 1-2 dígitos de dentro do texto (ex.: "Grupo 25", "25 - VACA")
      40:   const m = s0.match(/(\d{1,2})/);
      41:   if (m) {
      42:     const n = Number(m[1]);
      43:     if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || n > 25) return "00";
      44:     return pad2(n);
      45:   }
      46: 
      47:   return "00";
      48: }

      50: export function validateRankingLineByLine(expectedCounts, rankingRows) {
      51:   const issues = [];
      52:   const gotMap = new Map();
      53: 
      54:   const ignoredExpectedKeys = [];
      55:   const ignoredRows = [];
      56: 
      57:   // expectedCounts normalizado
      58:   const expectedNorm = {};
      59:   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(expectedCounts || {})) {
>>    60:     const g = normalizeGrupo(k);
      61:     if (g === "00") {
      62:       ignoredExpectedKeys.push(String(k));
      63:       continue;
      64:     }
      65:     expectedNorm[g] = toNumber(v);
      66:   }
      67: 
      68:   // soma rows por grupo
      69:   for (const r of rankingRows || []) {
      70:     const rawG = r?.grupo ?? r?.group;
      71:     const g = normalizeGrupo(rawG);
      72:     if (g === "00") {
      73:       ignoredRows.push({ rawGrupo: rawG, row: r });
      74:       continue;
      75:     }
      76: 
      77:     const val = toNumber(r?.apar ?? r?.total ?? r?.count ?? r?.value ?? 0);
      78:     gotMap.set(g, toNumber(gotMap.get(g)) + val);
      79:   }
      80: 
      81:   const allGroups = Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => pad2(i + 1));
      82: 
      83:   let okCount = 0;
      84:   let diffCount = 0;
      85: 
      86:   for (const g of allGroups) {
      87:     const expected = toNumber(expectedNorm?.[g] ?? 0);
      88:     const got = toNumber(gotMap.get(g) ?? 0);
      89:     const delta = got - expected;
      90: 
      91:     const status = delta === 0 ? "OK" : "DIF";
      92:     if (status === "OK") okCount += 1;
      93:     else diffCount += 1;
      94: 
      95:     issues.push({ grupo: g, esperado: expected, obtido: got, delta, status });

       9:     Array.isArray(positions) && positions.length

      13:       : null;

      27: export function extractIntInRange(value, min, max) {
      28:   if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;

      30:   if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) {
      31:     const n = Math.trunc(value);
      32:     return n >= min && n <= max ? n : null;
      33:   }

      36:   if (!s) return null;
      37:

      39:     const n = Number(s);
      40:     return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= min && n <= max ? n : null;

      27:  * buildPalpiteV2 — (NOVO) Palpite por FREQUÊNCIA + ANTIGUIDADE

      31:  * - Gerar palpite 4 dígitos ("milhar") POR GRUPO (01..25)

      33:  *
      34:  * Critérios:
      35:  * - Dezena: mais frequente

      38:  * - Empate: mais ANTIGA

      58:   if (!s0) return "";

      73: function normalizeDigitsOnly(v) {

      75:   if (!s) return "";
      76:   return s.replace(/\D+/g, "");

     145: function normalizeToYMD(input) {
     146:   if (!input) return null;
     147: 
     148:   // Firestore Timestamp com toDate()
     149:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
     150:     const d = input.toDate();
     151:     if (d instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
     152:       return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;
     153:     }
     154:   }
     155: 
     156:   // Timestamp-like { seconds } / { _seconds }
     157:   if (
     158:     typeof input === "object" &&
     159:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) || Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
     160:   ) {
     161:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
     162:       ? Number(input.seconds)
     163:       : Number(input._seconds);
     164:     const d = new Date(sec * 1000);
     165:     if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
     166:       return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;
     167:     }
     168:   }

     119:   const dezDigits = normalizeDigitsOnly(dez);

     123:     if (centDigits.length === 2) return toMilhar4(centDigits);
     124:   }
     125: 
     126:   if (dezDigits && dezDigits.length >= 2) {
     127:     return toMilhar4(dezDigits.slice(-2));
     128:   }
     129: 
     130:   return null;
     131: }

     173: /**
     174:  * ✅ Dedup defensivo de prizes dentro do mesmo draw
     175:  * - prioridade: prizeId (se existir)
>>   176:  * - fallback: position + grupo + animal
     177:  * - se position vier vazio, ainda assim diferencia por "idx" para não colapsar tudo
     178:  */
     179: function dedupePrizes(prizes) {
     180:   const arr = Array.isArray(prizes) ? prizes : [];
     181:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
     182: 
     183:   const seen = new Set();
     184:   const out = [];
     185: 
     186:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
     187:     const p = arr[i];
     188: 
     189:     const grupoRaw = p?.grupo ?? p?.group ?? "";
     190:     const animalRaw = p?.animal ?? "";
     191:     const posRaw = p?.posicao ?? p?.position ?? "";
     192: 
     193:     const baseFallback = `${String(posRaw)}__${String(grupoRaw)}__${normalizeAnimalLocal(animalRaw)}`;
     194:     const key =
     195:       (p?.prizeId != null && String(p.prizeId)) ||
     196:       (String(posRaw).trim() ? baseFallback : `${baseFallback}__idx${i}`);
     197: 
     198:     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
     199:     seen.add(key);
     200:     out.push(p);
     201:   }
     202: 
     203:   return out;
     204: }

     436: function skipSourceless(line: SourceMapSegment[], index: number): boolean {
     437:   // The start of a line is already sourceless, so adding a sourceless segment to the beginning
     438:   // doesn't generate any useful information.
     439:   if (index === 0) return true;
     440: 
     441:   const prev = line[index - 1];
     442:   // If the previous segment is also sourceless, then adding another sourceless segment doesn't
     443:   // genrate any new information. Else, this segment will end the source/named segment and point to
>>   444:   // a sourceless position, which is useful.
     445:   return prev.length === 1;

>>   418: function sliceGeneratedPositions(
     419:   segments: ReverseSegment[],
     420:   memo: MemoState,
     421:   line: number,
     422:   column: number,
     423:   bias: Bias,
     424: ): GeneratedMapping[] {
     425:   let min = traceSegmentInternal(segments, memo, line, column, GREATEST_LOWER_BOUND);
     426: 
     427:   // We ignored the bias when tracing the segment so that we're guarnateed to find the first (in
     428:   // insertion order) segment that matched. Even if we did respect the bias when tracing, we would
     429:   // still need to call `lowerBound()` to find the first segment, which is slower than just looking
     430:   // for the GREATEST_LOWER_BOUND to begin with. The only difference that matters for us is when the
     431:   // binary search didn't match, in which case GREATEST_LOWER_BOUND just needs to increment to
     432:   // match LEAST_UPPER_BOUND.
     433:   if (!bsFound && bias === LEAST_UPPER_BOUND) min++;
     434: 
     435:   if (min === -1 || min === segments.length) return [];
     436: 
     437:   // We may have found the segment that started at an earlier column. If this is the case, then we
     438:   // need to slice all generated segments that match _that_ column, because all such segments span
     439:   // to our desired column.
     440:   const matchedColumn = bsFound ? column : segments[min][COLUMN];
     441: 
     442:   // The binary search is not guaranteed to find the lower bound when a match wasn't found.
     443:   if (!bsFound) min = lowerBound(segments, matchedColumn, min);
     444:   const max = upperBound(segments, matchedColumn, min);
     445: 
     446:   const result = [];
     447:   for (; min <= max; min++) {
     448:     const segment = segments[min];
     449:     result.push(GMapping(segment[REV_GENERATED_LINE] + 1, segment[REV_GENERATED_COLUMN]));
     450:   }
     451:   return result;
     452: }
     453:

     439:   // to our desired column.
     440:   const matchedColumn = bsFound ? column : segments[min][COLUMN];
     441: 
     442:   // The binary search is not guaranteed to find the lower bound when a match wasn't found.
     443:   if (!bsFound) min = lowerBound(segments, matchedColumn, min);
     444:   const max = upperBound(segments, matchedColumn, min);
     445: 
     446:   const result = [];
     447:   for (; min <= max; min++) {
     448:     const segment = segments[min];
     449:     result.push(GMapping(segment[REV_GENERATED_LINE] + 1, segment[REV_GENERATED_COLUMN]));

     263:          */
     264:         remoteAddress(): AddressInfo;
     265:         /**
     266:          * Broadcasts a datagram on the socket.
     267:          * For connectionless sockets, the destination `port` and `address` must be
     268:          * specified. Connected sockets, on the other hand, will use their associated
     269:          * remote endpoint, so the `port` and `address` arguments must not be set.
     270:          *
     271:          * The `msg` argument contains the message to be sent.
     272:          * Depending on its type, different behavior can apply. If `msg` is a `Buffer`,
     273:          * any `TypedArray` or a `DataView`,
     274:          * the `offset` and `length` specify the offset within the `Buffer` where the
     275:          * message begins and the number of bytes in the message, respectively.
     276:          * If `msg` is a `String`, then it is automatically converted to a `Buffer` with `'utf8'` encoding. With messages that
     277:          * contain multi-byte characters, `offset` and `length` will be calculated with
>>   278:          * respect to `byte length` and not the character position.
     279:          * If `msg` is an array, `offset` and `length` must not be specified.
     280:          *
     281:          * The `address` argument is a string. If the value of `address` is a host name,
     282:          * DNS will be used to resolve the address of the host. If `address` is not
     283:          * provided or otherwise nullish, `'127.0.0.1'` (for `udp4` sockets) or `'::1'` (for `udp6` sockets) will be used by default.
     284:          *
     285:          * If the socket has not been previously bound with a call to `bind`, the socket
     286:          * is assigned a random port number and is bound to the "all interfaces" address
     287:          * (`'0.0.0.0'` for `udp4` sockets, `'::0'` for `udp6` sockets.)
     288:          *
     289:          * An optional `callback` function may be specified to as a way of reporting
     290:          * DNS errors or for determining when it is safe to reuse the `buf` object.
     291:          * DNS lookups delay the time to send for at least one tick of the
     292:          * Node.js event loop.
     293:          *
     294:          * The only way to know for sure that the datagram has been sent is by using a `callback`. If an error occurs and a `callback` is given, the error will be
     295:          * passed as the first argument to the `callback`. If a `callback` is not given,
     296:          * the error is emitted as an `'error'` event on the `socket` object.
     297:          *
     298:          * Offset and length are optional but both _must_ be set if either are used.
     299:          * They are supported only when the first argument is a `Buffer`, a `TypedArray`,
     300:          * or a `DataView`.
     301:          *
     302:          * This method throws `ERR_SOCKET_BAD_PORT` if called on an unbound socket.
     303:          *
     304:          * Example of sending a UDP packet to a port on `localhost`;
     305:          *
     306:          * ```js

     490:         /**
     491:          * Trace a callback-receiving function call. This will always produce a `start event` and `end event` around the synchronous portion of the
     492:          * function execution, and will produce a `asyncStart event` and `asyncEnd event` around the callback execution. It may also produce an `error event` if the given function throws an error or
     493:          * the returned
     494:          * promise rejects. This will run the given function using `channel.runStores(context, ...)` on the `start` channel which ensures all
     495:          * events should have any bound stores set to match this trace context.
     496:          *
>>   497:          * The `position` will be -1 by default to indicate the final argument should
     498:          * be used as the callback.
     499:          *
     500:          * ```js
     501:          * import diagnostics_channel from 'node:diagnostics_channel';
     502:          *
     503:          * const channels = diagnostics_channel.tracingChannel('my-channel');
     504:          *
     505:          * channels.traceCallback((arg1, callback) => {
     506:          *   // Do something
     507:          *   callback(null, 'result');
     508:          * }, 1, {
     509:          *   some: 'thing',
     510:          * }, thisArg, arg1, callback);
     511:          * ```
     512:          *
     513:          * The callback will also be run with `channel.runStores(context, ...)` which
     514:          * enables context loss recovery in some cases.
     515:          *
     516:          * To ensure only correct trace graphs are formed, events will only be published if subscribers are present prior to starting the trace. Subscriptions
     517:          * which are added after the trace begins will not receive future events from that trace, only future traces will be seen.
     518:          *
     519:          * ```js
     520:          * import diagnostics_channel from 'node:diagnostics_channel';
     521:          * import { AsyncLocalStorage } from 'node:async_hooks';
     522:          *
     523:          * const channels = diagnostics_channel.tracingChannel('my-channel');
     524:          * const myStore = new AsyncLocalStorage();
     525:          *
     526:          * // The start channel sets the initial store data to something
     527:          * // and stores that store data value on the trace context object
     528:          * channels.start.bindStore(myStore, (data) => {
     529:          *   const span = new Span(data);
     530:          *   data.span = span;
     531:          *   return span;
     532:          * });

     135:         /**
     136:          * Unlike the 16 KiB default `highWaterMark` for a `stream.Readable`, the stream
     137:          * returned by this method has a default `highWaterMark` of 64 KiB.
     138:          *
     139:          * `options` can include `start` and `end` values to read a range of bytes from
     140:          * the file instead of the entire file. Both `start` and `end` are inclusive and
     141:          * start counting at 0, allowed values are in the
     142:          * \[0, [`Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Number/MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)\] range. If `start` is
     143:          * omitted or `undefined`, `filehandle.createReadStream()` reads sequentially from
>>   144:          * the current file position. The `encoding` can be any one of those accepted by `Buffer`.
     145:          *
     146:          * If the `FileHandle` points to a character device that only supports blocking
     147:          * reads (such as keyboard or sound card), read operations do not finish until data
     148:          * is available. This can prevent the process from exiting and the stream from
     149:          * closing naturally.
     150:          *
     151:          * By default, the stream will emit a `'close'` event after it has been
     152:          * destroyed.  Set the `emitClose` option to `false` to change this behavior.
     153:          *
     154:          * ```js
     155:          * import { open } from 'node:fs/promises';
     156:          *
     157:          * const fd = await open('/dev/input/event0');
     158:          * // Create a stream from some character device.
     159:          * const stream = fd.createReadStream();
     160:          * setTimeout(() => {
     161:          *   stream.close(); // This may not close the stream.
     162:          *   // Artificially marking end-of-stream, as if the underlying resource had
     163:          *   // indicated end-of-file by itself, allows the stream to close.
     164:          *   // This does not cancel pending read operations, and if there is such an
     165:          *   // operation, the process may still not be able to exit successfully
     166:          *   // until it finishes.
     167:          *   stream.push(null);
     168:          *   stream.read(0);
     169:          * }, 100);
     170:          * ```
     171:          *
     172:          * If `autoClose` is false, then the file descriptor won't be closed, even if
     173:          * there's an error. It is the application's responsibility to close it and make
     174:          * sure there's no file descriptor leak. If `autoClose` is set to true (default
     175:          * behavior), on `'error'` or `'end'` the file descriptor will be closed
     176:          * automatically.
     177:          *
     178:          * An example to read the last 10 bytes of a file which is 100 bytes long:
     179:          *

     195:          *

     198:          * It is the application's responsibility to close it and make sure there's no

     746:   var value = val;
     747:

     749:     // concat the new and prev vals
     750:     value = Array.isArray(prev) ? prev.concat(val)
     751:       : Array.isArray(val) ? [prev].concat(val)
     752:         : [prev, val]
     753:   }
     754: 
     755:   return this.set(field, value);

     146: function detectEncoding(buf, defaultEncoding) {
     147:     var enc = defaultEncoding || 'utf-16le';
     148: 
     149:     if (buf.length >= 2) {
     150:         // Check BOM.
     151:         if (buf[0] == 0xFE && buf[1] == 0xFF) // UTF-16BE BOM
     152:             enc = 'utf-16be';
     153:         else if (buf[0] == 0xFF && buf[1] == 0xFE) // UTF-16LE BOM
     154:             enc = 'utf-16le';
     155:         else {
     156:             // No BOM found. Try to deduce encoding from initial content.
     157:             // Most of the time, the content has ASCII chars (U+00**), but the opposite (U+**00) is uncommon.
     158:             // So, we count ASCII as if it was LE or BE, and decide from that.
>>   159:             var asciiCharsLE = 0, asciiCharsBE = 0, // Counts of chars in both positions
     160:                 _len = Math.min(buf.length - (buf.length % 2), 64); // Len is always even.
     161: 
     162:             for (var i = 0; i < _len; i += 2) {
     163:                 if (buf[i] === 0 && buf[i+1] !== 0) asciiCharsBE++;
     164:                 if (buf[i] !== 0 && buf[i+1] === 0) asciiCharsLE++;
     165:             }
     166: 
     167:             if (asciiCharsBE > asciiCharsLE)
     168:                 enc = 'utf-16be';
     169:             else if (asciiCharsBE < asciiCharsLE)
     170:                 enc = 'utf-16le';
     171:         }
     172:     }
     173: 
     174:     return enc;
     175: }

     644:  * Generates a key schedule using the AES key expansion algorithm.
     645:  *
     646:  * The AES algorithm takes the Cipher Key, K, and performs a Key Expansion
     647:  * routine to generate a key schedule. The Key Expansion generates a total
     648:  * of Nb*(Nr + 1) words: the algorithm requires an initial set of Nb words,
     649:  * and each of the Nr rounds requires Nb words of key data. The resulting
     650:  * key schedule consists of a linear array of 4-byte words, denoted [wi ],
     651:  * with i in the range 0 <= i < Nb(Nr + 1).
     652:  *
     653:  * KeyExpansion(byte key[4*Nk], word w[Nb*(Nr+1)], Nk)
     654:  * AES-128 (Nb=4, Nk=4, Nr=10)
     655:  * AES-192 (Nb=4, Nk=6, Nr=12)
     656:  * AES-256 (Nb=4, Nk=8, Nr=14)
     657:  * Note: Nr=Nk+6.

>>   672:     byte's position (shifting the other bytes left).

     677:     4 to 44 (exclusive). Each time we iterate 4 times, i / Nk will

     902:       shift(1, 4) = 1
     903:       shift(2, 4) = 2

     905: 
     906:       This causes the first byte in r = 1 to be moved to the end of

     908:       the row, the first 3 bytes in r = 3 to be moved to the end of
     909:       the row:

     911:       r1: [c0 c1 c2 c3] => [c1 c2 c3 c0]
     912:       r2: [c0 c1 c2 c3]    [c2 c3 c0 c1]

>>   917:       state (note the columns have changed positions):
     918: 
     919:       c0 c1 c2 c3 => c0 c1 c2 c3
     920:       c0 c1 c2 c3    c1 c2 c3 c0  (cycled 1 byte)
     921:       c0 c1 c2 c3    c2 c3 c0 c1  (cycled 2 bytes)

     927:       c'0 = 1*r0,c0 + 2*r1,c1 + 3*r2,c2 + 1*r3,c3

     128:      */
     129:     function readString() {
     130:         var re = stringDelim === "'" ? stringSingleRe : stringDoubleRe;
     131:         re.lastIndex = offset - 1;
     132:         var match = re.exec(source);
     133:         if (!match)
     134:             throw illegal("string");

     136:         push(stringDelim);
     137:         stringDelim = null;

     152:      * Sets the current comment text.
     153:      * @param {number} start Start offset
     154:      * @param {number} end End offset
     155:      * @param {boolean} isLeading set if a leading comment
     156:      * @returns {undefined}
     157:      * @inner
     158:      */
     159:     function setComment(start, end, isLeading) {
     160:         var comment = {
     161:             type: source.charAt(start++),
     162:             lineEmpty: false,
     163:             leading: isLeading,
     164:         };
     165:         var lookback;
     166:         if (alternateCommentMode) {
     167:             lookback = 2;  // alternate comment parsing: "//" or "/*"
     168:         } else {
     169:             lookback = 3;  // "///" or "/**"
     170:         }
     171:         var commentOffset = start - lookback,
     172:             c;
     173:         do {
     174:             if (--commentOffset < 0 ||
     175:                     (c = source.charAt(commentOffset)) === "\n") {
     176:                 comment.lineEmpty = true;
     177:                 break;
     178:             }

     260:  * already parsed to an object). According to the spec, source maps have the
     261:  * following attributes:
     262:  *
     263:  *   - version: Which version of the source map spec this map is following.
     264:  *   - sources: An array of URLs to the original source files.
     265:  *   - names: An array of identifiers which can be referrenced by individual mappings.
     266:  *   - sourceRoot: Optional. The URL root from which all sources are relative.
     267:  *   - sourcesContent: Optional. An array of contents of the original source files.
     268:  *   - mappings: A string of base64 VLQs which contain the actual mappings.
     269:  *   - file: Optional. The generated file this source map is associated with.
     270:  *
     271:  * Here is an example source map, taken from the source map spec[0]:
     272:  *
     273:  *     {
     274:  *       version : 3,
     275:  *       file: "out.js",
     276:  *       sourceRoot : "",
     277:  *       sources: ["foo.js", "bar.js"],
     278:  *       names: ["src", "maps", "are", "fun"],
     279:  *       mappings: "AA,AB;;ABCDE;"
     280:  *     }
     281:  *
     282:  * The second parameter, if given, is a string whose value is the URL
     283:  * at which the source map was found.  This URL is used to compute the
     284:  * sources array.
     285:  *
     286:  * [0]: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1U1RGAehQwRypUTovF1KRlpiOFze0b-_2gc6fAH0KY0k/edit?pli=1#
     287:  */

     456:   if (match) {
     457:     var source = match[1];

     462:     var contents = fileContentsCache[source];

     465:     if (!contents && fs && fs.existsSync(source)) {
     466:       try {
     467:         contents = fs.readFileSync(source, 'utf8');
     468:       } catch (er) {
     469:         contents = '';
     470:       }

     472: 
     473:     // Format the line from the original source code like node does
     474:     if (contents) {
     475:       var code = contents.split(/(?:\r\n|\r|\n)/)[line - 1];
     476:       if (code) {
     477:         return source + ':' + line + '\n' + code + '\n' +
     478:           new Array(column).join(' ') + '^';
